name: A slow dependency takes down the whole service
description: Four product page API instances with 32 slots each; every request reads Postgres, then calls the recommendation service (timeout 1 s). From second 20 the recommendation service becomes 50 times slower. Every API slot waits on it, so even the work that does not need it cannot run: the queue fills up and about half of the requests fail. Recommendations are only a nice extra, yet they take down the whole product page. Try the "Bulkhead + fallback" version.
